name: Tormenting the Tormented lets Tormentor's damage over time critically strike (#692)
contract: Tormenting the Tormented 805758 reads 'Your Tormentor can now critically strike.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 21, with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT (286) and class mask word 2 = 0x10000000, the flag word of every Tormentor rank (Tormentor has periodic damage on effect 0 and does not carry SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT). AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1175) returns the caster's crit chance for a spell matched by an aura-286 mask and 0 otherwise, and AuraEffect::PeriodicTick recomputes it on every tick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1160), so it must go from 0 to positive on the live aura once the passive is learned. The pattern is the one of scenarios/witchdoctor-hex-of-malice-periodic-crit.json. The class base crit is not fixed by any fixture rating, so Houndfeeder 705477 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT +4, DBC) supplies a guaranteed positive crit chance; without 805758 the periodic effect still reads 0 because CalcPeriodicCritChance returns 0 with no aura 286 in range. CORRECTION from a slot 3 run: the crit chance is not recomputed on each tick. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodicData (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:658-671) is the only writer of the stored crit chance and runs when the aura effect is created or its timers are refreshed (Aura::RefreshTimers, SpellAuras.cpp:855), so an aura applied before the talent was learned keeps 0 (measured: still 0 six seconds later). The scenario therefore recasts Tormentor after learning the talent, as a player would when the passive is taken before the cast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Houndfeeder, for a guaranteed positive crit chance
Without the talent the periodic effect cannot critically strike
Give Rage for the second cast
Recast Tormentor so its aura is created with the talent active
The recast aura carries the caster's crit chance
